question: Should Telegram expose standalone `pin` and `unpin` message-tool actions, and what gate plus target semantics should protect those privileged chat-state mutations?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the feature changes persistent Telegram chat state through bot credentials and current config has no pin-specific gate or approved implicit-unpin contract.

options.title: Approve gated explicit actions
options.body: Add Telegram-plugin-owned `pin` and `unpin` actions behind an explicit action gate, require `messageId` unless a separate implicit mode is approved, and require live Telegram proof before merge.

options.title: Keep delivery pin only
options.body: Do not expose standalone pin/unpin actions yet; keep the existing `delivery.pin` capability for messages OpenClaw just sent.

options.title: Request design first
options.body: Ask for a short design note covering admin-right expectations, per-account gating, implicit unpin behavior, and forum-topic semantics before implementation.

recommendation.title: Approve gated explicit actions
recommendation.body: Add Telegram-plugin-owned `pin` and `unpin` actions behind an explicit action gate, require `messageId` unless a separate implicit mode is approved, and require live Telegram proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The requested decision extends Telegram message-tool discovery and action-runtime seams that gumadeiras consolidated.
